description: frozen-state monthly momentum, B=100%/N=30%, top15, buffer20, vol cap 0.55, truncate-then-drop affordability, explicit full exits

engine.exec_timing: T close signal -> T+1 open fill
engine.st_filter: INERT (panel isst always 0) - documented known gap

state.label_semantics: state evaluated at T close, actionable T+1 open
state.missing_state_behaviour: FAIL with DATA_UNAVAILABLE; MUST NOT fall back to N and MUST NOT reuse stale state

selection.vol: std(pct_change() over the last 61 return observations)*sqrt(252)  [code: iloc[-61:], 61 obs; NOT exactly 60]
selection.affordability: truncate to top_n first, then drop names with 100*raw_close > budget*1.02; budget = exposure*nav/top_n; NO backfill
selection.rebalance: last trading day of month; first frozen date initialises; B<->N changes do NOT trigger an extra immediate rebalance; E/C exit target is issued at that close and attempted next open

prohibited_changes: no parameter search on N=85/90 or top_n 15/20
no use of 2024-09+ performance to change rules

known_behaviour.empty_candidates: set empty target book (sell all), recorded as cash reason no_candidate
known_behaviour.pending_order_expiry: 20 trading days (engine max_pending_days), then target_book_expired event
known_behaviour.blocked_exit: carried daily, retried at next open; over-target holdings possible up to expiry
